items.title: Public Examinations Bill Passed in Rajya Sabha
items.whyInNews: The Rajya Sabha passed the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, through a voice vote on July 31, 2026.
items.summary: The Public Examinations Bill aims to strengthen the examination system in India by preventing unfair means. Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised the passage of the bill, stating it will help in conducting fair and transparent examinations. The bill will now be sent to the President for assent.
